models.composition: River God Rems — attributed to Carlo or Domenico Ferretti
models.qualification: A mature bearded, muscular river god reclining with one knee raised, a fish beneath the right hand and a tipped water jar beside the left arm. The exact source still and an independent photograph of the physical Stuttgart sculpture were actually opened and matched by the researcher. Stuttgart city and Dehio identify the Mittlerer Schlossgarten object, with attribution probably Carlo Ferretti or his son Domenico, early or mid-18th century. Do not present the publisher's 1748–1753 date or Domenico attribution as certain. Secondary literature calls the present garden example a copy of the palace roof figure; present-example production date and original/copy status need further primary confirmation and must remain qualified. Preserve weathering and historic condition. Digital physical scale remains unverified. Current exact model is downloadable CC BY 4.0 and isAiGenerated:false. models.composition: Reclining Neptune Fountain — anonymous, Monforte Gardens
models.qualification: A mature bearded Neptune reclining above a fierce sea animal on a fountain in Monforte Gardens, Valencia. The exact source still and two independent photographs of the physical sculpture were actually opened and matched by the researcher: head and beard, raised hand, other hand resting on the sea animal, spread legs, body position and fountain rocks. City cultural guide entry 31 identifies this reclining Neptune as anonymous, 1849; do not confuse it with the separate standing crowned Triton/Neptune in the same garden or the Ponsonelli Neptune in the Parterre. A secondary photo site supplies a conflicting Ponsonelli attribution; retain the city guide's anonymous attribution and qualify the date as that guide's dating. City restoration notices in 2022 document damage and reattachment of fingers and trident; the source capture lacks the long trident and must retain its recorded condition. Count the entire fountain group once, excluding an earlier incomplete scan UID 43ae74d6340649d18da67169318f8d8b. Preserve original color, vegetation and geometry pending native suitability review. Physical scale remains unverified. Current exact model is downloadable CC BY 4.0 and isAiGenerated:false.
